name: bar-list
title: Bar list
description: A React bar list: a ranked top-N chart with a soft bar behind each name, compact in cards and a plain list to screen readers. A Tremor-style bar list. MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Bar list: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/bar-list

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { BarList, BarListTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/bar-list";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
